name: Entity Resolution
description: Resolve multiple references to the same real-world entity into a canonical entity. Entity resolution uses attribute matching, relationship analysis, and manual confirmation.
purpose: Eliminate entity duplication in the knowledge graph by identifying when different references point to the same real-world entity and merging them into a single canonical representation.
acceptanceCriteria: Entity resolution matches by: name similarity, attribute overlap, shared relationships
Resolution can be automatic (high confidence) or suggested (low confidence)
Resolved entities merge triples onto the canonical entity
Resolution record is preserved for audit
Un-resolve operation exists for correcting false positive merges
rollback_strategy: Split merged entities; restore pre-resolution identity assignments
recovery_strategy: Rebuild canonical entity index from entity resolution journal
